name: Birth of Henry VIII
description: Henry VIII was born in Greenwich, London, England. He was the third child and second son of Henry VII and Elizabeth of York.

name: Henry becomes Duke of York
description: Henry was granted the title, Duke of York. His older brother Arthur was the Prince of Wales at that time.

name: Death of Arthur, Prince of Wales
description: Arthur, Prince of Wales, dies unexpectedly. Henry becomes heir apparent to the throne of England.

name: Marriage to Catherine of Aragon
description: Henry VIII marries his brother's widow, Catherine of Aragon.

name: Accession of Henry VIII
description: Upon the death of his father, Henry VIII becomes the King of England.

name: Birth of Mary I
description: Mary I, also known as Mary Tudor, the only child of Henry VIII and Catherine of Aragon who survived infancy, was born.

name: Begin of Reformation in England
description: Henry VIII starts the English Reformation by separating the Church of England from the Roman Catholic Church.

name: Marriage to Anne Boleyn
description: Henry VIII marries Anne Boleyn after his marriage to Catherine of Aragon was annulled.

name: Birth of Elizabeth I
description: Elizabeth I, the daughter of Henry VIII and Anne Boleyn, was born.

name: Execution of Anne Boleyn
description: Anne Boleyn was executed on charges of adultery, incest, and treason.

name: Marriage to Jane Seymour
description: Henry VIII marries Jane Seymour, his third wife.

name: Birth of Edward VI
description: Edward VI, son of Henry VIII and Jane Seymour, was born. He is the only legitimate son of Henry VIII.

name: Death of Jane Seymour
description: Jane Seymour died of postnatal complications, and Henry VIII was genuinely distraught at her death.

name: Death of Henry VIII
description: Henry VIII dies at the age of 55, possibly due to obesity-related health issues. His son Edward VI succeeds him.
